title: Sequence Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🎬️sequence plugin (7 old constitutional crates: manifest/artifact bundle, app facade, engine, op, pack, protocol, dsl, ui) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ (crate name semio-s-plugin-sequence, preserved from the old bundle crate) with the full taxonomy source tree (🗿️artifacts/🎬️sequence/{component,diff,op,dsl,pack,spr,engine}, 🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/{component,config,terminology,wasm,commands/*,modes/edit/windows/*,panels/*}), following the W1 flow-pilot recipe in TEMPLATE.md (26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md) exactly. This is W2 fan-out work, file-ownership scoped exclusively to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/**. Verify with cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, cargo test (baseline preservation + wire-format byte-identical diff), delete old crate manifests only after green, and end with a registrar handoff report (never touching root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/script.ts/registry/launch.json myself).
summary:
Migrated the 🎬️sequence plugin's 8 old constitutional crates (manifest/artifact bundle, app facade, engine, op, pack, protocol, dsl, ui) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ (semio-s-plugin-sequence, name preserved) with the full taxonomy source tree, following TEMPLATE.md's W1-flow-pilot recipe.

Taxonomy layout: 🗿️artifacts/🎬️sequence/{component,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine} (all entity types, SequenceOperation/SequenceDiff, DocumentDsl/DocumentPack impls, SequenceHost + engine helpers) plus 🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/{component,config,terminology,wasm,🎮️commands/{🪜️step,🔗️connection,🕸️node-graph,🔄️layout,🗂️selection,🏃️run,🗣️locale},🎭️modes/✏️edit/🪟️windows/{📽️main,📜️script,🧬️compiled},📌️panels/{📄️document,🛍️catalogue,🔍️inspection}}. SequenceCommand rebuilt via app_commands! (18 rows, keyed form, no ctx needed). SequenceConfig/SequenceConfigOperation moved from the old engine/op crates into app config.rs. wasm_session bridge moved verbatim into app wasm.rs, cfg-gated at the mod declaration in 📦️lib.rs.

Verification (isolated via temporary [workspace] overlay, deleted before handoff): cargo check (native) clean; cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 clean; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean (fixed: unused imports, unnecessary qualifications, module_inception risk on the "run" command group renamed to Rust module `playback`, needless_pass_by_value on camera conversion fns, unnecessary_wraps, map_unwrap_or/is_none_or simplifications — one instance kept as map+unwrap_or_else with an #[allow] because map_or_else would require a &mut self closure and an immutably-borrowed-self closure in the same call, which the borrow checker rejects); cargo test 122 passed, 0 failed (baseline floor was 101 across the 8 old crates). Wire-format byte-identical: captured hex dump of all 19 SequenceCommand variants + StepsAdd operation from the old protocol crate before migration, re-dumped from the new crate after, diffed line-by-line — all identical. Found and fixed one real bug during this process: the SequenceCommand's SetLocale row was initially wired "setLocale" as "locale" (copying flow's documented id/keyword divergence) when sequence's actual pre-migration wire key was "set-locale" — caught by the wire-format tests, fixed before finalizing.

Framework gap fixed in passing: the old sequence-ui crate's wasm32 target dependencies were missing an explicit `js-sys` dependency despite using `js_sys::Promise`/`js_sys::Array` in its wasm_session bridge (pre-existing gap, never caught because that module is wasm32-only and cargo test never builds it) — added `js-sys = "0.3.83"` (matching the version already used by other plugins, e.g. 📏️layout) to the new crate's wasm32 target deps.

Cross-plugin dependent found and fixed: 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml (and its 📦️lib.rs) dev-depended on the old semio-s-app-sequence facade for SequenceFixture — repointed to the new semio-s-plugin-sequence crate at sequence::artifacts::sequence::SequenceFixture, following the exact precedent already established there by the writer/vcs/animate/shooting/cad migrations. No 🎪️demonstrator dependency on sequence found.

Old crate directories deleted only after all checks passed: 🛂️manifest/, 🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/⚡️implementations/, 🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/🔨️modules/. Did not touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root script.ts, the registry script, or .vscode/launch.json — registrar handoff block delivered separately to the orchestrator.

    "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/🔨️modules/🔧️op/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust",
    "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust",
    "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/🔨️modules/📡️protocol/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust",
